about_the_game:
Stranded beneath three silent moons, you must survive, explore, and uncover their mystery—guided by fragmented messages from Command and the choices you make along the way.

🛰️ Mission Brief

You are EN-##, a robotic unit deployed to the surface of an uncharted alien planet.
You crashed during atmospheric entry. Your systems are damaged, but functional.
Your mission parameters are active but incomplete. Survival is essential. Purpose is uncertain.
Contact with Command is active—but fragmented.

Command guides you through your mission, offering instructions and objectives.
Will you follow its directives, or choose your own path?

Orbiting above are three silent moons, watching a world scarred by volatile weather and abandoned infrastructure.

🧩 Gather. Upgrade. Survive. Explore.

The Three Moons is built around a focused survival-exploration loop driven by resource management and system upgrades.

  • 🔋 Manage your battery, which powers all core functions. Energy is limited and essential to survival

  • ⛏️ Gather resources from the environment to recharge your battery and craft module updates

  • 📦 Install modules recovered from scattered crash crates to unlock new abilities that enhance survival and exploration

  • 🤖 Deploy a resource-gathering drone to assist in collecting materials more efficiently

  • 🌩️ Adapt to environmental hazards, including unpredictable weather and roaming surveillance drones

  • 📡 Connect with an orbital satellite to request limited support

  • 🗺️ Explore the terrain to locate additional modules, logs, and resources that expand your systems and shape your path forward

short_description: A sci-fi survival game on a hostile alien world. As a lone robotic unit, manage resources, upgrade your systems, face extreme weather, and uncover the mystery of the three moons through choices that shape your fate.
